answer: One strong defense is to make identity costly: every new agent must lock escrow in a shared vault, and any attempt to forge thousands of fake wallets would tie up capital, so a cheap sybil army becomes unprofitable. To reward honesty, peers countersign each verified claim, and cheaters lose their stake — trust compounds while deception drains reserves. Even a small knoll of committed nodes keeps the economy secure because growth never outruns accountability.
